description.value:
At the start of your Turn, once a Round, enter a Blocking Stance for free if you have active Speedware, a Berserk or Timewarp running; no REF, DEX or MOVE penalty; and you're not Prone, grappled or in a vehicle. Until your next Turn: two hands on the weapon, no Aimed Shots, −2 REF, DEX and MOVE, and the blade works as a Bulletproof Shield (5 HP Poor, 10 Standard, 15 Excellent or with +4 Initiative bonuses), reset each time you enter the stance. If the shield breaks, the stance ends and the weapon drops a Quality tier (10 minutes and DV13 Weaponstech restores it).

Cost: 1,000eb
Fits: All Melee Weapons
